git-commit.description: Writing a commit for a diff that bundles multiple motives, before determining which ones are actually independent
git-commit.rationale: Excessive Ana without Non (every hunk is read and tagged by motive, but the independent clusters are never ruptured apart — Kata compresses all of them into one message instead of Bind closing each rupture on its own, so the contradiction between motives is papered over rather than resolved)

documentation.description: Docs have drifted from the code they describe; reconciling before it compounds
documentation.rationale: In the Void relative to the source of truth (∅), need Axis (ground in current behavior) and Bind (commit the reconciled doc)

meta-prompting.description: Recursive over-refinement while drafting a prompt or instruction for another agent
meta-prompting.rationale: Meta ∘ Meta loop on the prompt itself (infinite reflection instead of a draft to test)

mindset.description: Perfecting an unvalidated approach before writing anything that runs
mindset.rationale: Excessive Ortho without Ana (correcting a design that hasn't been explored yet)

code-review.description: Reviewing a PR by listing inline nits before locating the structural issue
code-review.rationale: Excessive Ana without Kata (every line reviewed before the structural issue is named)
